'''PC Errata''' are Players Committee corrections distinct from Decipher printed text (and distinct from Decipher Glossary Supplement letter-<code>d</code> / legacy <code>-DE</code> errata).

On this wiki:

* '''Human title convention:''' PC-only game-text changes are titled '''Title (PC Errata)''' (example shape: ''Sense (PC Errata)''). '''<code>card_uid</code>:''' bare GEMP id is the PC playable id when a PC delta exists (example: <code>3_1</code> on [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (PC Errata)]]). Print/Original uses letter suffix <code>o</code> (example: <code>3_1o</code>). Do '''not''' teach <code>-PC</code> / <code>-OR</code> as playable ids &mdash; see [[Card versions]].
